```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Dynamic-demand scenario family: source-to-receptor distance, maximum instantaneous charge, and predictive level; longitudinal, transverse, and vertical PPV targets; and number of realizations per scenario."
if (!exists("CAP.DOCX.FORMAT", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP.DOCX.FORMAT <- paste(
    "PPV target ranges by component for %d demand scenarios over",
    "D = %.0f--%.0f m and MIC = %.0f--%.0f kg at p = %s; the family",
    "contains %s three-component realizations."
  )
}
if (!exists("BIG.MARK", inherits = FALSE)) BIG.MARK <- ","
PathAudit <- file.path(root, "data", "audit", "summary.csv")
if (!file.exists(PathAudit)) {
  stop("scenarios: audit summary is missing.", call. = FALSE)
}
DT <- fread(PathAudit)
COLS <- c("ScenarioID", "D", "MIC", "n.records")
if (length(setdiff(COLS, names(DT))) || !nrow(DT) ||
    DT[, anyDuplicated(ScenarioID)] ||
    DT[, any(!is.finite(D) | !is.finite(MIC) |
             !is.finite(n.records) | n.records < 1L)]) {
  stop("scenarios: scenario inventory is incomplete or invalid.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
P <- sub("^.*\\.(p[0-9]+)$", "\\1", DT$ScenarioID)
if (any(P == DT$ScenarioID)) {
  stop("scenarios: predictive level is absent from ScenarioID.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
P <- sort(unique(as.numeric(sub("^p", "", P)) / 100))
P <- paste(formatC(P, format = "f", digits = 2L), collapse = ", ")
CAP.DOCX <- sprintf(
  CAP.DOCX.FORMAT,
  nrow(DT), min(DT$D), max(DT$D), min(DT$MIC), max(DT$MIC), P,
  format(sum(DT$n.records), big.mark = BIG.MARK, scientific = FALSE,
         trim = TRUE)
)
rm(COLS, DT, P)
```

:::{.content-visible when-format='docx'}

```{r}
#| include: true
#| eval: !expr knitr::pandoc_to("docx")
#| label: tbl-scenarios-executive
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP.DOCX
EXECUTIVE <- TRUE
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "tbl", "scenarios.R"))
TBL
```
